title: Established Locations: Reduction of the New Agreement Security Deposit Multiple
content:
An established sister location lowers the multiple of a Security Deposit on a new agreement still pending start.

**Clause.** Where the estimate of the new agreement's monthly bill is drawn from a sister agreement, the customer's other active Electric Service Agreement on the same rate schedule, that has been in service at least 120 whole months on the assessment date, 0.25 comes off the multiple; where from one in service at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months, 0.1 comes off; otherwise nothing comes off.

**Counting.** Service length runs from the sister agreement's start date to the assessment date. Whole months between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the same day of a later month, a month whose day has not yet been reached on the later date not counting.

| Estimate source | Sister agreement's whole months in service | Taken off the multiple |
|---|---|---|
| Sister agreement | 120 or more | 0.25 |
| Sister agreement | 60 to 119 | 0.1 |
| Sister agreement | Fewer than 60 | Nothing |
| The kind's default average monthly bill | Not applicable | Nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Sister agreement start date | Assessment date | Whole months | Taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 April 2016 | 5 April 2026 | 120 | 0.25 |
| 5 April 2016 | 4 April 2026 | 119 | 0.1 |
| 5 April 2021 | 4 April 2026 | 59 | Nothing |
